messages.subject: Tinn-R  and rJava - XLConnet
parts:
Dear friends - I noticed that rJava did not load and therefore the use of the very convenoent XLConnect package failed when starting a session from within Tinn. Running the same commands in a clean R session was painfree. I believe this was not always so - would like to have Tinn-R running always - so is this a known problem?

Best wishes
Troels

messages.subject: Re: Tinn-R and rJava - XLConnet
parts:
Dear friends - thanks a lot - it was simple, and I found with help from
Martin Studer that it was missmatch between 32 and 64 bit - so from
Tinn I set up the call to R 64 bit -- that was the problem - so solved!

All best wishes

Troels
